english.title: Local government officer fail to disclose interest in contract
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an officer employed under the

(A)_[Local Government Act 1972]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE ACT..)]_

by the **(..SPECIFY THE LOCAL AUTHORITY..), and it having come to your knowledge that a contract in which you had a pecuniary interest,

(C)_[had been]_
(D)_[was proposed to be]_

entered into by that authority or a committee thereof, failed as soon as practicable to give notice in writing to the authority of the fact that you were interested in it
english.legislation: Contrary to section 117(1) and (3) of the Local Government Act 1972.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being an officer employed by a local authority
who knew that a contract in which you had a pecuniary interest
had been or had been proposed to be entered into by the authority or a committee thereof
failed to, as soon as practicable, give notice in writing to the authority of the fact that you were interested therein

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
